language.footer: Used for new meetings. Auto follows both languages in one meeting.

error.busy: A recording or import is running. Try again when it finishes.
error.offline: Strict offline mode is on, so nothing can be sent or downloaded.
error.noModel: Download the voice model first (Settings → Models).
error.micPermission: Microphone access is off. Turn it on in Settings.
error.busyRecording: A recording is running. Finish it first.
error.tooShort: That was too short. Read the whole passage.
error.tooQuiet: Too quiet. Move closer and try again.
error.noAuthMethod: Turn on a passcode in Settings to use app lock.

models.title: Models
models.footer: Models run on this phone. They are downloaded once and never sent anywhere.

voice.title: Voice profile
voice.footer: The profile stays encrypted on this phone. Delete it any time.
voice.noModel: The voice model isn’t downloaded yet. Get it in Models.
voice.deleteConfirm: Delete your voice profile? Your voice samples are erased for good and can’t be recovered.

consent.title: Consent message
consent.footer: Shown when you start recording so you can tell people. Leave empty to use the built-in text.

cloud.title: Cloud notes
cloud.footer: Only transcript text is ever sent, never audio, and only after you preview and confirm it for one meeting.
cloud.redactDefault: Hide names and personal data by default
cloud.keyFooter: Stored in this phone’s Keychain. It is never shown again.
cloud.offerFooter: Off by default. When on, “Improve with cloud” appears in a meeting. Each send is still your choice per meeting, previewed first, and audio never leaves.

about.title: About
about.licencesFooter: Full license texts ship with the app.

vocab.title: Custom vocabulary
vocab.hint: Names, products and jargon. The final transcript is corrected towards these words.
vocab.full: The list is full. Remove a term to add another.
vocab.learnedHeader: Learned from names you gave speakers
vocab.learnedFooter: These are used too. Remove one to stop correcting towards it.
vocab.learnedEmpty: Nothing yet. Names you give speakers appear here.

packs.footer: Common terms for a field. They help the notes spell the terms that were said. They never change the transcript.

about.legal: Contracts, courts, property and company law.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.footer: Start a recording during a calendar event and {{app}} names the meeting after it and keeps the attendees’ names with that meeting, encrypted on this phone. Events are read only when needed and are never stored.
calendar.statusConnected: Reading your calendar on this phone.
calendar.denied: {{app}} can’t read your calendar. Turn on Calendars → Full Access for {{app}} in Settings, then come back.
calendar.disconnected: Calendar turned off. To take back the permission too, use Settings → {{app}}.

privacy.title: Privacy and security
privacy.networkFooter: {{app}} only goes online for model downloads and cloud notes you confirm.
privacy.retentionFooter: When audio expires it is deleted. Transcripts and notes stay.
privacy.exportAllHint: An encrypted archive of every meeting.

deleteAll.title: Delete everything?
deleteAll.body: Every meeting, voice profile, key and setting on this phone is erased for good. This can’t be undone.

export.title: Export everything
export.body: Pick a password. Without it the file can’t be opened, and anyone with both gets every meeting.

log.title: Cloud request log
log.footer: Every time notes were sent to a cloud provider. Only the meeting, provider and size are kept, never the text.
log.empty: Nothing has been sent to the cloud.

storeProblem.title: {{app}} can’t open your meetings

reason.keyMissing: The key that unlocks your meetings is kept on this phone only, and it isn’t here now. This can happen after resetting the phone, restoring a backup onto a new phone, or erasing the Keychain.
reason.keyLocked: Your meetings’ key is protected while this phone or {{app}} is locked. Unlock with Face ID or your passcode, then try again.
reason.keystore: This phone’s secure key storage didn’t answer.
reason.damaged: Your meeting data can’t be read. It may be damaged.
reason.migration: Your meeting data couldn’t be updated to this version of {{app}}. Nothing was changed.
reason.disk: This phone couldn’t read or write {{app}}’s files. Check that it has free space.
reason.other: Something went wrong while opening your meetings.

storeProblem.startFreshNote: Starting fresh erases the meetings that can’t be opened and starts {{app}} over from the beginning.

confirm.title: Start fresh?
confirm.body: Everything {{app}} saved on this phone, including the meetings that can’t be opened now, is erased for good. This can’t be undone.

failed.title: {{app}} couldn’t load
failed.body: Something went wrong while starting. Your meetings haven’t been changed.

lock.title: {{app}} is locked
lock.body: Your meetings stay private until you unlock.

inbox.title: Waiting to import
inbox.processedOnPhone: Imported files are processed on this phone.

cloudSheet.templateFallback: This meeting uses one of your own templates, so the built-in General template is sent. Your instructions never leave your computer.
cloudSheet.title: Improve with cloud
cloudSheet.intro: Only the transcript text leaves this phone, never audio. You see exactly what is sent before anything goes.
cloudSheet.redactionOffWarn: Names and personal data will be sent as written.
cloudSheet.locked: Cloud is off for this meeting (“Never send to cloud”). Turn that option off in the meeting’s options to send.
cloudSheet.sent: Notes were rewritten with the cloud.
cloudSheet.failed: The cloud didn’t answer, so your notes stay on this phone.
cloudSheet.failedLeft: The request may already have reached {{provider}}.
cloudSheet.warningsIntro: This still looks like personal data:
cloudSheet.retention: {{provider}} handles this text under the terms of your account there; {{app}} can’t see or control how long it’s kept.
cloudSheet.cloudOff: Cloud notes are off. Turn on “Offer cloud notes” in Settings → Cloud notes first.
